algorithm: hierarchical VLA: frozen VLM high-level planner (bounding-box affordance) + DiT diffusion-policy controller conditioned on frozen DINOv2 features and a SAM+Cutie object mask, trained end-to-end from scratch by imitation learning (MSE noise-prediction loss); Immiscible Diffusion noise assignment; DDIM sampling (16 of 50 training steps)
success_criterion: "A grasp is successful if the object is held 10 cm above the table for 20 s."
headline_metric: aggregated zero-shot grasp success rate (Table 1c, 1,287 unseen object/background/lighting combinations)
headline_value: 90.8% aggregated (Ours@1 attempt); 94.7% (Ours@2); 96.9% (Ours@3); vs. π0 (Full FT) 30.3%, RDT (Full FT) 31.1%, OpenVLA-OFT (LoRA) 30.3% on the smaller-scale baseline comparison (Table 1a)
paper_code_mismatch: Hardware-interfacing code is explicitly withheld ("Due to intellectual property constraints, we are unable to open-source the hardware-related code"); only function signatures for the controller loss (compute_loss, noise_assignment) are present in code/md, not their bodies, so the MSE/Immiscible-Diffusion loss cannot be verified against code.
note_gaps: Table 1 is badly flattened in the PDF→markdown conversion (columns interleave across sub-tables 1a-1e); numbers were reconstructed by cross-checking against prose restatements of each number in §5.2-5.7, which all matched exactly.
backbone: Qwen-VL-Chat (default planner for all experiments except long-horizon); Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct (long-horizon task only)
params: 72B (long-horizon planner variant, Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct); Qwen-VL-Chat parameter count not stated; the trainable controller itself has 163M parameters (excludes the frozen VLM planner and frozen DINOv2 encoders)
action_head: DiT (Diffusion Transformer) controller performing bidirectional self-attention over noised action tokens and cross-attention to fused DINOv2 (head ViT-B/14 + wrist ViT-L/14) and mask-ViT observation features, predicting noise ε (MSE loss); Immiscible Diffusion noise assignment; DDIM inference (16 of 50 steps); action chunk horizon H=64, executes first 6 actions before replanning at 20Hz control rate
dexterous_evidence: "As shown in Figure 3, our setup includes a 7-DoF RealMan RM75-6F arm and a 6-DoF PsiBot G0-R hand." (Sec. 5.1, Experiment Setups)
